rules: Do not bulk import the entire AmbientCG library into SVR.
Use AmbientCG as an approved CC0 asset source.
Prefer 1K or 2K textures for Quest/browser runtime.
Only optimized final runtime files may enter game/assets/open/ambientcg/runtime.
Do not touch website/site files in this game-side asset phase.

sources.name: ambientCG
sources.allowedUse: Textures, HDRIs, materials, selected models after optimization
sources.runtimeUse: Local optimized copies only; no bulk library import

sources.name: Poly Haven
sources.note: Use as offline import source; do not call live API from game runtime.
